rule.104_role: already observed stability holdout; not used for this fitting
rule.105_role: exploratory background only, no numerical fitting
rule.comparison: descriptive counts only; no winner, p-value, population specificity or predictive-superiority verdict on 107
rule.decision_time: first eligible regular state with reference minus current score >= 2; after generation, before next optimizer update
rule.episode_spacing: no new episode through previous onset + 50, inclusive

feature_definition.always_recover: constant RECOVERED_WITHIN_50 at the same episode onset
feature_definition.low_loss_examples: same as stable_examples with eight selected by low calibration loss
feature_definition.mean_loss: max(0, median(token-weighted mean loss, recent5) - median(token-weighted mean loss, past15))
feature_definition.mean_loss_variability: max(0, population std(mean loss, recent5) - population std(mean loss, past15))
feature_definition.stable_examples: median of per_example_rise for frozen eight stable examples

rule.feature_window: 20 states t-19..t, split into 15 past and 5 recent states; identical cutoff for all methods
rule.future_leakage_test: changing all observations after t must leave its prediction unchanged

future_stress_pilot.assignment: each seed crossed with all three multipliers; fresh trajectory per combination; no checkpoint restore to branch
future_stress_pilot.outcomes: behavioral labels only; numerical stops separate; no guaranteed mix of classes
future_stress_pilot.status: design recorded; no executable pilot and no automatic launch in this notebook
future_stress_pilot.stop_policy: fixed pilot grid; absent either class => pilot insufficient; no automatic search or validation launch
future_stress_pilot.validation_design: number of independent runs, class balance, effect size and success criterion to be frozen after pilot and before any validation run

rule.no_episodes: episode mechanics NON_VALUTABILE; report collection completion separately
rule.prediction_assumption: an anomaly larger than all six observed recovered calibration episodes predicts no confirmed recovery within 50; otherwise predicts recovery; unvalidated hypothesis
rule.recovery_confirmation: two consecutive future regular scores >= reference minus 1, both within 50; use complete future window or CENSORED
rule.reference: median of previous three regular exact-match counts; fixed within episode
rule.selection: mean ascending average-tie ranks across seeds 103/106 in states 300..399; lower index breaks selection ties
rule.success: technical ONLY: complete 450 updates, valid predictions committed before next update, exact offline replay and at least one episode
rule.threshold_interpretation: one-class exploratory envelope, not a learned separation of outcomes and not calibrated false-alarm control
rule.threshold_rule: for each nonconstant method, maximum score among the six fully observed D=2 calibration episodes; strict exceedance predicts no confirmed recovery
